title: How to organise the cleaning and utility zone | Mudroom
description:
The tools that keep the entry floor and the door mats fit to walk on, kept where the mess actually lands.

This is the Cleaning and Utility Zone in the Mudroom. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Broom, mop and dustpan clipped to the wall with their heads hanging clear of the floor, the vacuum parked flat against the wall inside a marked outline, and one caddy holding the four cleaners you genuinely use, each in its own labelled bottle.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Line every bottle up on the floor and read them.
Straighten: Clip each long-handled tool near its head so the bristles hang clear of the floor and the handle points down.
Shine: Rinse the mop head and let it dry fully before it goes back on its clip, cut the hair off the vacuum's brush b
Safety: Never keep bleach and an ammonia-based cleaner in one closed caddy, because a leaking cap in a shut box mixes
Standardize: The mop, broom and dustpan hang, and the vacuum parks inside its outline; nothing in this corner stands on the
Sustain: When you shake the door mats out, hang the broom back on its clip and feel whether the mop head has dried.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Every tool hangs with its head clear of the floor, nothing goes away wet, and bleach never shares a container with anything else.
